using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using BossRush;
using UnityEngine;
class Program
{
    static void Main()
    {
        DragonKingBossGunRuntime.RequestFireExplosionEffectWarmup(2);
        UniTask.Advance(); UniTask.Advance();
        if (DragonKingBossGunRuntime.Count != 2 || DragonKingBossGunRuntime.Running) throw new Exception("normal warmup control failed");
        Console.WriteLine("CONTROL normal: requested 2, pool=2, running=false");
        DragonKingBossGunRuntime.ClearFireExplosionEffectPool();
        DragonKingBossGunRuntime.RequestFireExplosionEffectWarmup(3);
        if (DragonKingBossGunRuntime.Count != 1 || !DragonKingBossGunRuntime.Running) throw new Exception("warmup did not yield");
        DragonKingBossGunRuntime.ClearFireExplosionEffectPool();
        DragonKingBossGunRuntime.RequestFireExplosionEffectWarmup(3);
        UniTask.Advance(); // Old finally must not clear the new running flag.
        if (!DragonKingBossGunRuntime.Running) throw new Exception("old finally released successor");
        UniTask.Advance(); UniTask.Advance(); UniTask.Advance();
        if (DragonKingBossGunRuntime.Count != 3 || DragonKingBossGunRuntime.Running) throw new Exception("pool did not restart");
        Console.WriteLine("PASS cancelled warmup restarts; old finally preserves successor");
    }
}
public static class UniTask
{
    static Queue<TaskCompletionSource<bool>> pending=new Queue<TaskCompletionSource<bool>>();
    public static int Pending=>pending.Count;
    public static Task DelayFrame(int frames){var t=new TaskCompletionSource<bool>();pending.Enqueue(t);return t.Task;}
    public static void Advance(){pending.Dequeue().SetResult(true);}
}
public static class TaskExtensions { public static void Forget(this Task value) { if(value.IsFaulted) throw value.Exception; } }
namespace UnityEngine
{
    public class GameObject { public bool Destroyed; public void SetActive(bool active){} }
    public static class Object { public static void Destroy(GameObject go){go.Destroyed=true;} }
    public static class Mathf { public static int Clamp(int value,int min,int max)=>Math.Clamp(value,min,max);public static int Max(int a,int b)=>Math.Max(a,b); }
}
namespace BossRush
{
    public class CharacterMainControl { public static CharacterMainControl Main = new CharacterMainControl(); }
    public static partial class DragonKingBossGunRuntime
    {
        private static bool IsProjectileWarmupOwnerValid(CharacterMainControl owner) { return owner != null; }
        /* POOL_METHODS */
        private const int MaxPooledFireExplosionEffects=96;
        private class FireExplosionEffectHandle { public UnityEngine.GameObject gameObject=new UnityEngine.GameObject(); }
        private static readonly Stack<FireExplosionEffectHandle> fireExplosionEffectPool=new Stack<FireExplosionEffectHandle>();
        private static int fireExplosionEffectPoolGeneration;
        private static bool fireExplosionEffectWarmupRunning;
        private static int requestedFireExplosionEffectPoolSize;
        private static FireExplosionEffectHandle CreateFireExplosionEffect()=>new FireExplosionEffectHandle();
        public static int Count=>fireExplosionEffectPool.Count;
        public static bool Running=>fireExplosionEffectWarmupRunning;
    }
}
